{{Quote|Exodeen lost its senior senator and its secondary senator. Now it is only represented by R'yet Coome. That's not good for any of us.|[[ChoFï]]|<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>}}
The '''Exodeen secondary senator''' was one of three [[Senator/Legends|senators]] representing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exodeen/Legends|Exodeen]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]. This senator was second in seniority behind [[M'yet Luure]], but ahead of junior senator [[R'yet Coome]]. In 17 ABY, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] senate chamber was rocked by numerous explosions. This senator was one of the numerous senators killed by the explosions.
